key_verdict: No disagreement; the setter's key is correct in both parts.
why: A plain sector from a diagram with one exact conversion mark and one sector-area mark in terms of π is exactly how SEAB has set circular measure at the front of Paper 1 (2011 P1 Q15 awards 1 mark for a sector area and asks for expressions in terms of π; 2012 P1 Q21(c) and 2023 P1 Q2(b) award 1 mark for a unit conversion); the imperatives, precision demands and mark discipline match, 12 cm with 150° gives clean multiples of π in both parts, and it re-skins none of the exemplars (they convert the other way, or find a composite shaded area, a perimeter in the form a + bπ, or a major arc inside a circle-properties question).
